description:
Average (2004-2020) climate for every suburb: daytime highs and overnight lows (annual, hottest and coldest month, every month), rainfall (annual, seasonal, monthly) and rain days, sunshine energy and afternoon humidity. **Modelled estimates.**

Coverage: About 15,300 suburbs and localities with a 5 km land grid cell within about 10 km of the suburb point; averaging period 2004-2020 (solar and humidity 2006-2020). Current to 2020-12-31. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/climate-normals`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: temp_max_annual_c, temp_min_annual_c, temp_mean_annual_c, temp_max_hottest_month_c, temp_min_coldest_month_c, diurnal_range_c, rain_annual_mm, rain_days_annual, rain_wettest_month_mm, rain_driest_month_mm, rain_summer_mm, rain_autumn_mm, rain_winter_mm, rain_spring_mm, solar_exposure_mj_m2_day, solar_exposure_summer_mj_m2_day, solar_exposure_winter_mj_m2_day, humidity_afternoon_pct, humidity_afternoon_summer_pct, humidity_afternoon_winter_pct, temp_max_jan_c, temp_max_feb_c, temp_max_mar_c, temp_max_apr_c, temp_max_may_c, temp_max_jun_c, temp_max_jul_c, temp_max_aug_c, temp_max_sep_c, temp_max_oct_c, temp_max_nov_c, temp_max_dec_c, temp_min_jan_c, temp_min_feb_c, temp_min_mar_c, temp_min_apr_c, temp_min_may_c, temp_min_jun_c, temp_min_jul_c, temp_min_aug_c, temp_min_sep_c, temp_min_oct_c, temp_min_nov_c, temp_min_dec_c, rain_jan_mm, rain_feb_mm, rain_mar_mm, rain_apr_mm, rain_may_mm, rain_jun_mm, rain_jul_mm, rain_aug_mm, rain_sep_mm, rain_oct_mm, rain_nov_mm, rain_dec_mm. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.
